flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4100 then On this checkout page, type 'Grace Hopper' into the Full name field and 'grace@example.com' into the Email field, then click the Place order button.
Wait up to 10 seconds for the page to react.
If the status message says there was a problem, @v16:"click the Place order button one more time and wait up to 10 seconds again".
Get the exact text of the status message shown under the form at the end and save as {{status_message}} (store 'none' if it is empty).
Get the HTTP status code of the last order request made and save as {{order_request_status}} (store 'no response' if that request got no response).
Do not judge the result.
Only record these two values.

order_request_status.code:
reqs = network.requests(method="POST", path="/api/order")
return str(reqs[-1].response_status) if reqs and reqs[-1].response_status is not None else "no response"
order_request_status.code_js: const reqs = network.requests({method: 'POST', path: '/api/order'}); const last = reqs[reqs.length - 1]; return last && last.responseStatus != null ? String(last.responseStatus) : 'no response';
